headlines.title: Lumentum Experts to Share Insights at ECOC 2026
headlines.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., September 15, 2026--Lumentum, a global leader in optical and photonic technology, today announced its speaker line-up at the 2026 European Conference on Optical Communications (ECOC) in Málaga, Spain. The event will be held from September 20 – 24 at the Trade Fair and Congress Center of Málaga. Visit Lumentum stand #2050.

headlines.title: What Does Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Mean For Investors After The LITEON Token Launch?
headlines.summary: LITEON, a tokenized financial product tied to Lumentum Holdings (NasdaqGS:LITE), has been launched to give investors economic exposure to the stock. The new token links blockchain infrastructure with the AI optics theme that surrounds Lumentum's role in data center hardware. LITEON is structured to track Lumentum's share performance and referenced AI data center drivers without altering Lumentum's underlying operations or cash flows.

headlines.title: Corning Tumbles 12% on $2B At-the-Market Equity Offering; Coherent Sinks 11%, Lumentum Drops 9%, Fabrinet Slides 6%
headlines.summary: A surprise equity filing sent Corning to the bottom of the S&P 500 and pulled the entire AI optical sector down with it, raising a pointed question about whether a stock that surged 67% this year just flashed a warning sign for the broader hyperscaler buildout trade.

headlines.title: Top Funds Bet Billions As This AI Stock Lights Up A Buy Zone
headlines.summary: Fueled by massive demand for AI data centers, the best mutual funds have bet billions on Lumentum stock, igniting shares.

headlines.title: AAOI's Optical Networking Demand Rise: Can It Beat LITE and COHR?
headlines.summary: Applied Optoelectronics is scaling 800G and 1.6T capacity as AI-driven optical demand surges, sharpening its challenge to major networking rivals.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
